title: Plan Relationship Credit — Total-Loss Cancellations of Kessler Care Prepaid Maintenance Plans
content:
**Relationship credit.** A Kessler Care Prepaid Maintenance Plans plan cancelled for a total loss earns a plan relationship credit according to how the plan was bought and the service history of its unit.

| The plan | Plan relationship credit (USD) |
|---|---|
| Was sold on a Kessler vehicle purchase deal | 20.00 |
| Was bought on its own, for a unit with at least one repair-order line at the group | 10.00 |
| Any other plan | None |

The repair-order lines are those recorded for the plan's unit in the Service Accounts and Repair Orders records. Any kind of line counts, and one is enough.

**Cases (hypothetical).**
- A plan written on the buyer's purchase deal earns 20.00, whatever the unit's service history.
- A plan bought on its own for a unit that has had one oil-change repair order at a Kessler store earns 10.00.
- A plan bought on its own for a unit never serviced at the group earns none.
